name: thinkingorbs
description: Animated dotted-sphere status orbs for AI agents.
author: Yogesh (https://yogesharc.com)

scripts.build: tsc -p . && node -e "for (const f of ['dist/orb.js', 'dist/orb.d.ts']) { const fs = require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync(f, fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8').replace('\"./orb-core\"', '\"./orb-core.js\"')); }"
